transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Honestly, Doctor, for the last four months I've had this unbelievable, unstoppable burst of energy and my mind is constantly racing! I feel incredibly happy and on top of the world one minute, but then I get so easily irritated and angry the next. I just can't seem to slow down or stop!

During these past four months, have you experienced any periods where your behavior was so extreme that you required hospitalization, or did it result in a complete inability to function at work or in your daily social life?

No, I haven't been hospitalized, and I definitely don't feel like I've been unable to function. If anything, I feel like I've been doing way more than usual and getting a lot of things done. I just feel incredibly active and productive.
Aside from these periods of high energy and productivity, have you experienced any times where you felt deeply sad, hopeless, or lost interest in the things you usually enjoy?

No, I haven't felt sad or hopeless at all, and I definitely haven't lost interest in things. If anything, my mood has been the complete opposite—I'm constantly energized and active. I feel like I have too much energy to ever feel down.

During these periods of high energy, have you ever experienced any unusual perceptions, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others do not, or have you held beliefs that others found strange or impossible?

Yes, during these high-energy times, I've sometimes heard whispering voices when no one is there and felt like I have a special mission or that people are watching me. These strange experiences only ever happen when my energy is this high, never when I'm feeling normal. It's like my mind is just running too fast.
